d: Intel has reportedly begun another round of layoffs as CEO Lip-Bu Tan pushes ahead with efforts to restructure the chipmaker, reduce costs and improve its competitiveness. According to a Business Insider report, the latest cuts have affected employees in Intel's global information technology workforce, although the company has not disclosed how many people have been affected or which teams are being targeted. The latest job cuts add to a wider workforce reduction. Intel's employee count fell to around 81,100 at the end of September, down from 85,100 at the end of 2025.
